observed.pricing_architecture: Fin is priced at $0.99 per resolved customer outcome. It may be used with Intercom support plans or with an existing helpdesk, where Intercom states a minimum commitment applies.

plans.name: Existing helpdesk deployment
plans.price_note: No Intercom seat cost; official FAQ describes a minimum monthly commitment.

free_access.note: Pricing is consumption-based; published deployment terms vary by support-stack choice.

expansion_vectors.description: Revenue scales with customer issues resolved by the agent.

analysis.monetization_summary: Fin connects its consumption unit to a support outcome rather than a seat or model input.
